objective: Test the unchanged R27 query-aligned RGB-D-to-RGB reprojection visibility scorer on five TARO-fresh OpenLORIS home trajectories.

source_authority.sensor: Intel RealSense D435i on a wheeled robot
source_authority.depth_contract: 848x480 aligned depth at 30 Hz; depth is aligned to color for per-pixel correspondence
source_authority.synchronization_contract: Data from the same RealSense camera are hardware synchronized
source_authority.groundtruth_contract: Offline LiDAR-SLAM world-to-base trajectory for non-office scenes; bind to the D435i color optical frame through the source calibration chain
source_authority.calibration_contract: D435i intrinsics are source-carried factory calibration and extrinsics are source-carried in the package

parent_cohort.cross_program_boundary: Earlier OpenLORIS work inspected office1-1..7, cafe1-1..2 and corridor1-1..2. Those exact parents are excluded; no prior result grants or removes authority from home1-1..5.

canonical_observation.rgb_preprocessing: Use the unchanged R27 luminance, gradient and texture plane implementation after the same center crop and resize.
canonical_observation.candidate_depth_read_boundary: Candidate depth remains unopened until source/reference/candidate identities and R27 selection scores have been sealed.

outcome_blind_selection.reference_selection: Reuse balanced_pose_source_frontdoor.select_pose_capable_references over the complete metadata/pose roster.
outcome_blind_selection.candidate_generation: Reuse task_evidence_oracle_canary.pose_proposal_pairs without reading task outcome or candidate depth.
outcome_blind_selection.generic_arm: Maximum translation, then rotation, then smallest gap, then deterministic frame identity.
outcome_blind_selection.passive_arm: Unchanged passive candidate from the frozen proposal row.

execution_order: Verify exact source object byte counts and SHA-256 values.
Extract only under artifacts.local and validate the five parent/calibration/index rosters.
Freeze frame, reference and candidate identities from timestamps and poses before opening image payloads.
Open reference RGB-D and candidate RGB only; compute and seal unchanged R27 selection scores.
Open selected candidate depth only for fresh source-derived task evidence metrics.
Evaluate every frozen gate once and emit an exclusive result artifact.
claim_ceiling: A PASS would be one fresh-family source confirmation of R27 task-evidence observability. It would not by itself prove broad generalization, collision correctness, Android readiness, product success, deployment readiness, navigation safety or user safety.
